ch.x:
PART 1 — LAUNCH YOUR EXPERT BUSINESS
Weeks 1–6

ch.c: sc-a0aea947-0 dOqGpd col-sm-12 col-12 col-md-12 col-lg-12

ch.x: WEEK 1 — IDENTITY BEFORE STRATEGY

Framework 1: Set Your GPS Before we build anything, you need to know where you are going. Not in theory. In actual numbers, actual clients, actual impact. Most Infopreneurs skip this step and spend years busy but directionless. We start here — with clarity so sharp you could cut glass with it.

Framework 2: Step Off the Brakes You already know enough to charge. The problem is not your knowledge — it is the invisible foot on the brake. The imposter syndrome. The "who am I to charge for this." The fear of being seen. This is the framework I wish someone had given me before I spent years giving it away for free. We name it, face it and remove it together. Nothing else in this programme works until this one does.

ch.c: sc-a0aea947-0 dOqGpd col-sm-12 col-12 col-md-12 col-lg-12

ch.x: WEEK 2 — YOUR PEOPLE AND YOUR POSITION

Framework 3: Build Your Bridge Someone in your city is lying awake tonight with a problem you already know how to solve. This framework helps you find exactly who that person is, exactly what they are struggling with, and exactly how to position yourself as the bridge they have been looking for.

Framework 4: Your Profitable Niche Not everything you know is worth the same amount of money. I will walk you through my Profitable Niche Positioning Checklist — the tool I use to find the specific corner of your expertise where passion, skill and real market demand collide. That is where the money lives.

ch.c: sc-a0aea947-0 dOqGpd col-sm-12 col-12 col-md-12 col-lg-12

ch.x: WEEK 3 — BUILD THE OFFER

Framework 5: Your 10X Client Stop trying to help everyone. I will help you define the one client who needs exactly what you offer, has the money to pay for it, and will become the case study that sells your next ten clients. Finding this person changes everything.

Framework 6: Design Your Signature Offer This is where your knowledge becomes a product. Not a vague "I offer consulting" — a specific, packaged, priced offer that a stranger can read and immediately understand the value of. We build it together. For the African market. Priced with confidence.

ch.c: sc-a0aea947-0 dOqGpd col-sm-12 col-12 col-md-12 col-lg-12

ch.x: WEEK 4 — THE MONEY ARCHITECTURE

Framework 7: Your Product Ecosystem One offer is a transaction. An ecosystem is a business. I will show you how to map the full ladder of offers — from the free entry point to the premium room — so that every client who finds you has somewhere to go and every sale leads to the next one.

Framework 8: Sales Funnel Design In the African market the funnel is a conversation — on WhatsApp, on Facebook, face to face. I will build with you the exact sequence that moves someone from "I saw your post" to "I have paid" — with manual and automated options that work on Zambian data and Zambian mobile money.

ch.c: sc-a0aea947-0 dOqGpd col-sm-12 col-12 col-md-12 col-lg-12

ch.x: WEEK 5 — GET CLIENTS BEFORE YOU ARE READY

Framework 9: Start Getting Customers You do not need a finished product to get paid. This is my validation methodology — the exact steps I use to confirm real market demand and collect real money before everything is built. If nobody pays in week 5, we redesign before you invest further. No wasted effort.

Framework 10: Visibility and Traffic You cannot sell a secret. I will help you build your organic visibility strategy on the platforms your audience actually uses — not LinkedIn if your buyer is on Facebook, not email if your buyer is on WhatsApp. We build where African buyers actually live.

ch.c: sc-a0aea947-0 dOqGpd col-sm-12 col-12 col-md-12 col-lg-12

ch.x: WEEK 6 — IMPLEMENTATION WEEK

No new frameworks this week. This week you finish what you started. Your offer is real. Your funnel exists. Your first client conversations are happening. We do not move to Part 2 until Part 1 is producing results — not just plans.

ch.c: sc-a0aea947-0 dOqGpd col-sm-12 col-12 col-md-12 col-lg-12

ch.x:
PART 2 — BRAND, MARKET AND SCALE
Weeks 7–12

ch.c: sc-a0aea947-0 dOqGpd col-sm-12 col-12 col-md-12 col-lg-12

ch.x: WEEK 7 — BE FINDABLE AND BELIEVABLE

Framework 11: SEO and Discoverability When someone searches for what you know, you need to appear. I will help you build your search presence so your expertise works for you at 2am while you are asleep — attracting the right people to the right offer without you lifting a finger.

Framework 12: Building Credibility In the African market trust is the currency and it cannot be faked. I will show you how to build your credibility architecture — the testimonials, the case studies, the receipts, the authority signals — that make the African buyer say yes before you have even asked.

ch.c: sc-a0aea947-0 dOqGpd col-sm-12 col-12 col-md-12 col-lg-12

ch.x: WEEK 8 — OWN YOUR PLATFORMS

Framework 13: Brand Profile Optimisation Every platform where you exist is either selling you or unselling you. We audit and rebuild your digital presence together so that every profile, every bio, every image tells the same story — the right story — to the right person.

Framework 14: LinkedIn for African Infopreneurs The most underused platform by African experts. While everyone else is fighting for attention on Facebook, your future corporate clients, speaking invitations and high-ticket opportunities are sitting on LinkedIn waiting. I will show you exactly how to get into those rooms.

ch.c: sc-a0aea947-0 dOqGpd col-sm-12 col-12 col-md-12 col-lg-12

ch.x: WEEK 9 — 24/7 LEADS

Framework 15: Fundamentals of Paid Advertising Your organic reach has a ceiling. Paid advertising removes it. I will teach you my African market ad methodology — built for mobile money buyers, WhatsApp-first audiences and people scrolling on expensive data who will not click on anything that feels like a scam.

Framework 16: PPC Hands-On You do not leave this session with notes. You leave with a live campaign. Budget set. Creative uploaded. Targeting locked. This is the session where theory becomes a running ad — and you finally understand what your money is actually doing.

ch.c: sc-a0aea947-0 dOqGpd col-sm-12 col-12 col-md-12 col-lg-12

ch.x: WEEK 10 — CLOSE AND CONVERT

Framework 17: Close More Leads Warm leads going cold is a Zambian epidemic. I will give you my WhatsApp and phone-based closing system — the exact conversation structure that turns "I am interested" into "I have paid" without pressure, without chasing and without discounting.

Framework 18: Making a Million Not inspiration. Not motivation. Actual mathematics. I will map with you the exact number of clients, at the exact price points, using the exact offer structure that produces serious revenue from your expert business. You will leave this session knowing your number and knowing your path.

ch.c: sc-a0aea947-0 dOqGpd col-sm-12 col-12 col-md-12 col-lg-12

ch.x: WEEK 11 — BUILD FOR FOREVER

Framework 19: Build Your Evergreen Offer An evergreen offer generates leads and revenue while you sleep, travel, rest or work on the next thing. I will help you design the offer that never expires — the one that works for you consistently without requiring your constant presence to keep it alive.

Framework 20: Your Long-Term Revenue Strategy This is the final framework and the most important one. This is where everything becomes a system — repeat business, automated leads, a product ecosystem that grows without you chasing every sale. This is where your expert business becomes sovereign.

ch.c: sc-a0aea947-0 dOqGpd col-sm-12 col-12 col-md-12 col-lg-12

ch.x: WEEK 12 — REVENUE ACTIVATION WEEK

No new frameworks. This week you go live. You run your first campaign. You close your first client from the system we built together. You do not graduate from this programme with a certificate and a dream. You graduate with revenue, a running system and proof that your knowledge is worth paying for.

ch.x: Frequently Asked Questions

ch.c: sc-a0aea947-0 dOqGpd col-sm-12 col-12 col-md-12 col-lg-12

ch.x: Is this online or physical?
Fully online. Join from anywhere in Zambia or across Africa. All you need is a smartphone or laptop and a stable internet connection.
What time are the sessions?
The Group Programme is self-paced with everyday chats and weekly assignments— no fixed session times. You work through the content when it suits your schedule.
Which days are the sessions?
Group Programme content is available daily from the programme start date of 1st April 2026. You set your own pace within the structure.
Do I need to be an expert or have formal qualifications?

No. If you’ve lived through something, solved a problem, or gained experience in any area — you can teach it. This book helps you organize and deliver what you know in a way people value and will pay for.

I have multiple passions. How do I know what to focus on?
You’re not alone.
Launch Your Expert Business Program
walks you through how to narrow your focus to something profitable, aligned, and energizing — even if you're multi-passionate.
What if I’ve never sold anything before?
Perfect. We have week 5-10 dedicated specifically to this. You’ll learn how to sell your knowledge with integrity — no sleazy tactics, no fancy tech, no huge audience required.
How long will it take me to launch my info product?
That depends on how fast you move. If you follow all the weekly assignments and actually do them, you will have a product before 90 days ends  .
What is the difference between Group Programme and Private VIP?
The Group Program is 90 days [3 months]
VIP is 6 months and has private personalised sessions.
Both programs give you the complete system with me guiding.
The learning enviroment, the duration and the price are different.
